BrochureContent.Content:
“Rosmeen” is a unique spacious family home (198 m2)  set on c .406 acre site of beautifully landscaped gardens to the front and rear. The property offers excellent privacy, with its setback position and a large rear garden surrounded by mature trees.


This 4 bedroom house features an eye-catching asymmetrical roofline, a classic brick and render façade, and a dramatic double-height feature window that floods the entrance with natural light. With multiple living areas, plus bedrooms on both ground and upper levels, it provides valued flexibility for family living. The large front driveway provides ample parking for multiple vehicles.

There is also a separate 2-storey semi-detached building (c. 53 m2) on site which offers further developmental opportunity (apartment / home business). 

The location of this home couldn’t be more family friendly with schools, shops and local amenities all within walking distance. 
Cork and neighbouring large towns are an accessible 30 minute commute.

With its generous size, central and quiet setting, this is an opportunity to secure a home that will tick many boxes.
